answer:
You pass the registry URI as the path argument to `scan-model`. The context doesn't show a separate flag for it.

**MLflow:** Use the `models:/` URI. "promptfoo scan-model models:/MyModel/Latest" [promptfoo/site/docs/model-audit/usage.md]. Set the tracking server and credentials as environment variables. "`MLFLOW_TRACKING_URI`: The URI of your MLflow tracking server." [promptfoo/site/docs/model-audit/usage.md] You can also set "`MLFLOW_TRACKING_USERNAME` / `MLFLOW_TRACKING_PASSWORD`: Credentials for MLflow authentication." [promptfoo/site/docs/model-audit/usage.md]

**JFrog Artifactory:** Pass the full artifact URL as the path. "promptfoo scan-model "https://your-domain.jfrog.io/artifactory/models/model.pkl"" [promptfoo/site/docs/model-audit/usage.md]. Set the base URL and token as environment variables. "`JFROG_URL`: The base URL of your JFrog Artifactory instance." [promptfoo/site/docs/model-audit/usage.md] You also need "`JFROG_API_TOKEN` or `JFROG_ACCESS_TOKEN`: Your API or access token." [promptfoo/site/docs/model-audit/usage.md]

Don't confuse this with the JFrog ML provider. That page says "This is different from **JFrog Artifactory**, which is supported in [ModelAudit](/docs/model-audit/usage#jfrog-artifactory) for scanning models stored in artifact repositories." [promptfoo/site/docs/providers/jfrog.md]
